notes: Offline edited session replay using the repository renderer and timeline adapter; no robot code executed.
Original master retained. Complete recording frame range retained monotonically; no source interval skipped.
Selected public text/tool excerpts only. Hidden thinking, injected skill instructions and system prompts excluded.
Public messages and submitted arguments appear at their recorded entry timestamp. Complete tool results and images appear at the corresponding recorded completion; no character timing is fabricated.

All submitted onboarding calls are retained. Simultaneous calls appear as one compact group with completed status only after their recorded results. Long arguments are explicitly truncated with ellipses; source arguments remain in provenance.
Recorded wall time is explicitly labeled. The ABB bridge provides no measured simulation clock.
After the raw recording ends, the final frame is visibly held for the original later snapshot read and final reply.
Fixed 4:3 framing extracts the RobotStudio scene; no optical flow or generated robot frames.
Displayed integer speed is filtered and labeled Accelerated above 1×, Playback at 1×, and Frame held at 0×; exact source mapping remains in speed_segments.

Device diagram shows actual abb/world profile IDs and uses IRB1200_5_90 URDF forward kinematics. Recorded joint endpoints match measured TCPs; intermediate joint poses are illustrative interpolation inside measured move-request/response intervals. The original video footage is unchanged.
Silent video. Scene-metadata perception and kinematic suction; no real-hardware or contact-physics claim.

Website addition preserves the corrected v4 master and delivery files byte-for-byte. Public provenance includes event timing and source hashes; full command arguments and local filesystem paths remain in the original local evidence bundle.
